Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Description: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.79 - Synced upstream Wrath Combo autorotperf (PR #1234)
- Autorotation performance pass: active job preset lists are now cached and only rebuilt when they change, reducing per-frame overhead.
- NIN: better prevents queueing duplicate mudras on high ping.
- Opener no longer resets on area / instance transitions - only on job change or first load.
- Fixed Ghimlyt Dark battle data.
- Added Vauthry invulnerability handling; Custom Actions window resized.
- Stability: Custom Actions disposed on framework teardown; guarded action-row lookups.
- All GluttonyCombo customizations preserved: Amnesia / Pacification / Silence handling, Pyretic / Reflect penalties, 15s raidwide-mitigation gate, WHM ground-heal targeting, SMN Aegis Uptime, BattleData, and IPC controls.
